book.name: Mɑɑku
book.title: LABAARI GEA NGE MƐ MAAKU U YORUA

content: Dĩɑ bwese yɛ̃kon ɡɑri
Yesu u kpɑm Gusunɔn ɡɑrin keu sɔ̃ɔsim wɔri dɑɑ burerun ɡoorɔ. Tɔn wɔru ɡunɑ yɑ mɛnnɑ yɑ nùn sikerenɑ, yen sɔ̃nɑ u bu deri ɡoorɔ u ɡoo duɑ ɡe ɡɑ wɑ̃ɑ nim sɔɔ, mɑ u sinɑ.
Mɑ u bu ɡɑ̃ɑ dɑbinu sɔ̃ɔsim wɔri kɑ mɔnnu. Win sɔ̃ɔsibu sɔɔ u ɡeruɑ u nɛɛ,
i swɑɑ dɑkio. Durɔ ɡoo u yɑrɑ u kɑ dĩɑ bweseru yɛ̃kɑ.
Sɑnɑm mɛ u yɛ̃kɑmɔ, sukum wɔrumɑ swɑɑ sɔɔ. Gunɔsu nɑ su di.
Sukum ɡɑm mɑɑ wɔri kpee sɑɑrɑ wɔllɔ mi tem kun duku. Mɑ mu kpiɑ yɑnde yèn sɔ̃ tem kun duku.
Adɑmɑ ye sɔ̃ɔ u bɔbiɑ mu dɔ̃ɔ mwɑɑrɑ mɑ mu ɡberɑ yèn sɔ̃ mu ǹ ɡbini mɔ.
Sukum ɡɑm mɑɑ kpɑm wɔri sɑ̃ki sɔɔ. Sɑ̃ki kpiɑ fuuku mɑ yi yinɑ mu kpɛ̃ɑ. Mu ǹ mɑrɑ.
Adɑmɑ sukum ɡɑm mɑɑ wɔrumɑ tem ɡem sɔɔ. Mu kpiɑ mɑ mu kpɛ̃ɑ mɑ mu mɑrɑ sukum tɛn tɛnibu, sukum wɑtɑ wɑtɑ, sukum wunɔm wunɔm.
Mɑ u nɛɛ, wi u swɑɑ mɔ u kɑ nɔ, u nɔɔwɔ.
Mɔnnun ɑsɑnsi
Sɑnɑm mɛ Yesu u tiɑ wi turo, be bɑ nùn swĩi kɑ bwɑ̃ɑbu wɔkurɑ yiru ye sɑnnu, bɑ nùn mɔnnun ɑsɑnsi bikiɑ.
U bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, bɛɛyɑ Gusunɔ u win bɑndun ɑsiri sɔ̃ɔsi, ɑdɑmɑ be bɑ tie bɑ ɡɑri kpuro nɔɔmɔ kɑ mɔnnu,
kpɑ

content.text: Bɑ̀ n mɑɑ nuɑ, kpɑ n ku bu yeeri,
kpɑ bu ku rɑɑ kɑ ɡɔ̃ru ɡɔsie,
Gusunɔ u sere bu suuru kuɑ.”

content: Mɔn ten tubusiɑnu
Mɑ u bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, mɔn teni tɑ ǹ bɛɛ yeeri? Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, ɑmɔnɑ ni nu tie kpuro nu koo kɑ bɛɛ yeeri.
Durɔ wi, Gusunɔn ɡɑriyɑ u yɛ̃kɑmɔ.
Tɔn be bɑ kɑ swɑɑ bɑɑru weenɛ mi bɑ ɡɑri yi yɛ̃kɑ, beyɑ bɑ̀ n ɡɑri yi nuɑ Setɑm dɑ nɛ u yi wunɑ ben ɡɔ̃run di.
Mɛyɑ mɑɑ be bɑ kɑ kpee sɑɑrɑn tem weenɛ, beyɑ bɑ̀ n ɡɑri yi nuɑ mii mii bɑ rɑ yi mwɛ kɑ nuku dobu.
Adɑmɑ bɑ ku rɑ n ɡbini mɔ ben tii sɔɔ, bɑ ku rɑ yɔ̃re n kɑ tɛ. Sɑnɑm mɛ wɑhɑlɑ kɑ nɔni swɑ̃ɑrɑ tunumɑ ɡɑri yin sɔ̃, yɑnde kpɑ bu biru wurɑ.
Gɑbɑ mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ be bɑ kɑ tem sɑ̃kunuɡum weenɛ. Beyɑ bɑ rɑ ɡɑri yi nɔ
ɑdɑmɑ bɑ rɑ n wurure kɑ ben hɑnduniɑn wɑ̃ɑru kpɑ dukiɑn kĩrɑ n bu tɑki dii. Bɑ ɡɑ̃ɑ dɑbinun kɔdɛ mɔ. Ye kpurowɑ yɑ rɑ ɡɑri yi tɛɛsi kpɑ yi kpɑnɑ yi binu mɑ.
Be bɑ mɑɑ kɑ tem ɡem weenɛ, beyɑ bɑ rɑ ɡɑri yi nɔ kpɑ bu yi mwɑ kpɑ bu binu mɑ, ɡɑbu tɛnɑ, ɡɑbu wɑtɑ, ɡɑbu wunɔbu (100).
Fitilɑn mɔndu
Yerɑ Yesu u bu bikiɑ u nɛɛ, bɑ rɑ fitilɑ ɡe ɡɑ sɔ̃re kɑɑru wukiri? Bɑ rɑ ɡu doke kpinun kɔkɔrɔ? Bɑ ku rɑ ɡu sɔndi dɑbu wɔllɔ?
Gɑ̃ɑnu sɑri ni nu beruɑ mɑ nu ǹ koo terɑ, ɑsirin ɡɑ̃ɑnu mɑɑ sɑri ni nu ǹ koo sɔ̃ɔsirɑ.
Wi u swɑɑ mɔ u kɑ nɔ, u nɔɔwɔ.
U mɑɑ bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, i lɑɑkɑri koowo ye i nɔɔmɔ. Sɑkɑku ɡe i kɑ yĩirumɔ, ɡeyɑ bɑ koo kɑ bɛɛ yĩiruɑ, kpɑ bu bɛɛ sosiɑ.
Domi wi u mɔ, wiyɑ bɑ koo sosiɑ. Adɑmɑ wi u kun ɡɑ̃ɑnu mɔ, piiko ye u mɑm mɔ bɑ koo nùn ye wɔrɑri.
Dĩɑ bwese te bɑ yɛ̃kɑn ɡɑri
Mɑ Yesu u nɛɛ, Gusunɔn bɑndɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe durɔ ɡoo wi u bweseru yɛ̃kɑ ɡberɔ.
U kpunɑmɔ wɔ̃kuru, u seemɔ bururu. Sɑɑ ye kpurowɑ bwese te, tɑ kpiimɔ tɑ kpɛ̃ɑmɔ. U ǹ yɛ̃ ɑmɔnɑ n koosinɑmɔ.
Temɑ mu kɑ mɛn tii tu kpiisiɑmɔ, ɡbiikɑɑ kpii nɔnu, yen biru kɛri, dɑ̃kuru kpɑ tu bɛm doke.
Sɑnɑm mɛ bɛm mu ye, kpɑ bu ɡɛ̃ kɑ kɔmbɔ domi ɡɛ̃ɛbun sɑnɑm mu turɑ.
Mutɑɑdin bimɑn ɡɑri
Yesu u kpɑm wure u nɛɛ, mbɑ sɑ ko kɑ Gusunɔn bɑndu weesinɑ. Kɑ mɔn terɑ̀ sɑ ko tu tubusiɑ.
Tɑ kɑ mutɑɑdin bimɑ weenɛ. Bɑ̀ n ye duurumɔ ɡberɔ, hɑnduniɑn ɡɑ̃ɑ bweseru kpuro sɔɔ yeyɑ yɑ piiburu bo.
Adɑmɑ bɑ̀ n ye duurɑ bɑ̀ n kpɑ yɑ rɑ kpɛ̃yɛ yu ko dɑ̃ru, kpɑ yu kɑ̃ɑsi bɛkɛ ko sere ɡunɔsu su sokunu ko yin kukɔsɔ.
Yesu u tɔn be Lɑbɑɑri ɡeɑn ɡɑri sɔ̃ɔwɑ kɑ mɔn dɑbinu nɡe nini, nɡe mɛ̀n sɑkɑ bɑ koo kpĩ bu nɔ.
U ǹ kɑ bu ɡɑri diri kue mɑ n kun mɔ kɑ mɔndu, ɑdɑmɑ ù n tiɑ kɑ win bwɑ̃ɑbu tɔnɑ, u rɑ bu kpuro tubusiewɑ.
Yesu u nim kurenu mɑrisiɑ
Tɔ̃ɔ ten yokɑ, u win bwɑ̃ɑbu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, i de su tɔburɑ ɡuru ɡiɔ.
Bɑ tɔn wɔru deri, mɑ bɑ duɑ ɡoo ɡe sɔɔ, mi u sɔ̃, bɑ tɔburɔ sɑnnu. Mɑ ɡoosu ɡɑsu bu swĩi.
Suɑru sɔɔ woo bɔkɔ ɡɑ nɑ kɑ dɑm mɑ nim kurenu wisi ɡoo sɔɔ sere ɡɑ kĩ ɡu yɑnde nim yibu.
Adɑmɑ Yesu u dò ɡoo sɔɔ biruɔ u leferi wiru kpĩiri. Bwɑ̃ɑ be, bɑ nùn yɑmiɑ bɑ nɛɛ, yinni n ǹ nun ɡɑm sɑ̃ɑ ye sɑ kɑm kobu dɔɔ?
Yerɑ u yɑndɑ mɑ u woo ɡerusi kɑ dɑm mɑ u nim kurenu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, n turɑ mɛ, i mɑrio sɛ̃ɛ. Woo ɡɑ mɑri mɑ yɑnde nim kurenu kpɑ.
Yerɑ u bu bikiɑ u nɛɛ, mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ i nɑndɑ nɡe mɛ. Amɔnɑ i ǹ kɑ mɑn nɑɑnɛ sɑ̃ɑ.
Ben yɑro suɑ mɑ bɑ bikiɑnɑmɔ, tɔnu weren bweserɑ wini wi bɑɑ woo kɑ nim kurenu nu mɛm nɔɔwɑmmɛ.
